MDMK exits DMK alliance after nine years

The MDMK party has ended its nine-year alliance with the DMK in Tamil Nadu. While the exact reasons for the split are not fully detailed across all reports, one outlet cited concerns about "Hindutva forces taking root." Following the announcement, reports indicate that a number of MDMK leaders and functionaries have joined the DMK.
